map.由半径与转角求切线长 使用指南: Tangent Length from Radius and Deflection Angle User Guide
map.输入圆曲线半径 R 与路线转角 Δ（度），按 T=R·tan(Δ/2) 计算切线: Enter the circular curve radius R and the route deflection angle Δ (degrees), then compute the tangent length as T = R·tan(Δ/2) — used for horizontal curve elements to fix the distance from the intersection to the curve's start and end points.
map.输入圆曲线半径 R 与转角 Δ（度），求切线长。: Enter the circular curve radius R and deflection angle Δ (degrees) to get the tangent length.
map.由半径转角算切线长 T。: Compute the tangent length T from the radius and deflection angle.
map.从交点量 T 定直圆点。: Set the curve points by measuring T from the intersection.
map.：R=200m、Δ=60° → T=R·tan(Δ/2)=200×tan30°≈: : R = 200 m, Δ = 60° → T = R·tan(Δ/2) = 200×tan30° ≈ 115.5 m; measure 115.5 m along each tangent from the intersection point PI to get the curve points ZY and YZ.
map.：T 是曲线放样起点基准，配合 L 定全线桩号。: : T is the baseline for the curve's setting-out start, and combined with L it fixes the chainage along the whole line.
map.T=R·tan(Δ/2)，Δ 为转角（曲线圆心角）。: T = R·tan(Δ/2), where Δ is the deflection angle (the central angle of the curve).
map.T 和 E 关系？: How Do T and E Relate?
map.T 沿切线、E 沿分角线，E=T·tan(Δ/4) 近似，几何不同方向。: T lies along the tangent while E lies along the external bisector, approximately E = T·tan(Δ/4) — they point in geometrically different directions.
